assets.prompt:
Production transparent sprite atlas for an existing HD arcade brawler. FOUR columns by SIX rows, exactly TWENTY FOUR equal square cells; portrait 2:3 overall canvas. Giorgos: CURLY blond hair, black belt, white gi, brown strapped sandals. Reference 1 is the APPROVED standing/carry transition source; reference 2 is existing attack/jump anatomy. Match reference1 identity, head size, face, exposure, detailed illustration style, colors and fixed full-body camera. This is a NEW action atlas. Face RIGHT in mild three-quarter view throughout. Full body visible in each cell, generous margin, one common baseline at 95% cell height and head at 5% in upright poses. Never enlarge heads, never fit each pose separately. Air poses fold legs within the same camera, actual world elevation is added in code. Transparent alpha-zero background, no shadows, no ground, no motion trails or blur, no writing, gridlines, frames, glow, colored residue or red fringes.
Rows 1+2 together are ONE eight-pose grounded club attack with smooth anticipation and recovery: row1col1 planted upright ready, wooden club held low near hip like reference1 first cell; col2 gentle shoulder wind-up, weight shifts back and club rises; col3 forward rotation with club descending diagonally; col4 fully extended forward strike at waist height, clear hand firmly around handle. Row2col1 follow-through lower across front; col2 elbow relaxes, club returns toward hip; col3 shoulders settle; col4 same planted ready pose as first. EXACTLY ONE small wooden club in each cell, physically continuous through hand, free arm balances. Keep feet planted except small pivot.
Row3 = FOUR consecutive CLUB JUMP poses: col1 shallow takeoff crouch with club low and secure; col2 toes leave floor and knees begin folding; col3 balanced apex with knees gently tucked and club held diagonally beside waist; col4 soft landing squat with club held near hip. Every cell includes ONE club, no duplicated weapon.
Row4 = FOUR matching LOAD JUMP poses: shallow crouch, lift-off, tucked apex, soft landing. NO club or object; both empty hands cradle an imaginary box in front of waist in stable supported palms-up grip. Hands must not pass through face, legs or each other. Runtime attaches the load.
Row5 = FOUR AIRBORNE CLUB STRIKE poses: tucked-leg airborne ready/backwindup, forward strike, follow-through, recovered airborne ready with club beside waist. Same identity, constant head size, one securely held club. Legs remain folded naturally rather than suddenly standing in air.
Row6 = FOUR two-handed THROW poses WITHOUT a prop: tuck imaginary box toward chest (palms at waist), small wind-up, both hands drive forward to release at shoulder/waist height, empty palms relax toward carry-ready. Keep feet planted and body readable. Hands in release must be extended, not clenched. Same fixed camera, 4x6 exact layout. The overall aim is continuous natural attacks/jumps that begin and end in the approved standing carry stance, not sudden unrelated drawings.

Rows ONE, TWO, THREE and FIVE must have EXACTLY ONE securely held wooden club per cell. Rows FOUR and SIX must remain completely empty handed. Do not move, enlarge or redesign any figure. Preserve fine face detail and all full-body silhouettes. Output truly transparent RGBA sprite atlas.

assets.cellRepairPrompt: Make a PRECISE local technical repair to this existing 4-column by 6-row transparent production sprite atlas. Preserve all 24 cell positions, every character silhouette, body/head size, faces, exposure, clothing, all hand registrations and all other weapons exactly. The ONLY repair is the club in ROW FIVE COLUMN ONE (frame16, airborne raised-fist backswing). Its tip currently crosses the TOP of its cell and contaminates the BOTTOM of ROW FOUR COLUMN ONE (frame12). Re-angle that ONE club BACK-LEFT/up from the raised fist so its entire silhouette, including blade and handle, lies at least 12 pixels inside frame16's 256x256 cell. The fist remains at its original position. Club tip points diagonally toward upper-left corner but stays inside margin, behind the head, never through hair or face. Erase the stray wood pixels that leaked into bottom of row4col1; restore full transparency around that previous figure's feet. Do not shift any body or change scale; do not erase that figure's sandals. Keep true alpha-zero backgrounds and opaque clean detailed character interiors, no haze, gradients, shadows or cell frames. Keep exact 1024x1536 canvas and 4x6 grid.

assets.prompt: Create ONE production transparent RGBA 4-column by 4-row sprite atlas of exactly 16 equal square cells. Reference1 is Giorgos (curly blond hair, black belt, white gi, brown sandals); reference2 is Thodoris (swept blond hair, blue belt, white gi, red sneakers). Preserve exact identities, constant head sizes, source camera, colors and fine detail. Every body faces RIGHT in mild three-quarter. Full bodies within cells, upright support at 95% cellheight. Zero-alpha background, opaque figure interiors and clean antialiased edges, NO haze, gradient, ground, shadow, letters, grid, trails or glow. ALL hands EMPTY; runtime supplies carried box. Row1: FOUR chronological AIRBORNE two-handed THROW poses for Giorgos: 1 knees tucked, both palms cradle imaginary box at waist; 2 small wind-up while knees remain tucked; 3 both hands extend FORWARD to release imaginary box; 4 hands relax, legs still tucked for descent. Row2: repeat these FOUR airborne throw poses for Thodoris. No standing legs in these first two rows, constant body/head sizes. Row3: FOUR chronological LOADED LANDING/RETURN poses for Giorgos: 1 shallow landing crouch with two palms holding imaginary box at waist; 2 knees extend halfway; 3 shoulders/hips settle upright; 4 planted ready carrying stance matching approved carry sheet. Row4: same FOUR loaded landing/return poses for Thodoris. Make smooth neighboring drawings, gentle weight transfer, anatomy consistent, realistic arm/leg continuity and stable load grip. Do NOT draw any club or carried object anywhere.
assets.runtime: Tucked airborne throw poses and four-pose loaded landing return for both heroes. Fixed camera per action family; head/camera calibration never varies per frame.
